text: Afai e te fa’alogoina lou fiafia tele e asiasi solo, fa’aaogā le avanoa e fai ai vai suamalie po o ni smoothies:
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: masalo e te ono mauaina se vaiinu faigofie e mafai ona fai ai sau ti o le taeao ina ua e toe foi i au gaioiga masani o aso uma.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Afai e te nofo i se taulaga e iai lana aga masani i inuga ‘ese’ese, alu i pa po o papu i tuā’oi e te lē alu soo iai.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Mo ē e le masani i ‘upu fa’afoma’i, o le ‘upu infectious and contagious e ‘ese’ese uiga.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: O se fa’ama’i pipisi (infectious) e mafua mai i mea ninii pei o se vairasi, siama, lega (fungus) po o isi mea ola ninii (parasite).
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: O le fa’ama’i pipisi (contagious) o se fa’ama’i e faigofie ona pepesi atu i lou iai i le nofoaga o le fa’ama’i po o le tagata ma’i.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: O le tele o faigamalō e mana’omia le ulufale atu o tagata asiasi, po o tagatanuu e tuua o latou atunuu ina ia faia o latou tui puipui mai le tele o fa’ama’i.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: O nei mea e mana’omia e masani ona fa’alagolago i atunuu sa āsia e le tagata malaga po o le fuafua e asiasi iai.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: O le tasi o itu malosi o Salote, o Karolaina i Matū, o le tele o filifiliga maualuga mo aiga.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: O tagata mai isi nofoaga e masani ona talanoa i le faigofie mo aiga ma o se mafua’aga o le siitia ai i o, ma tagata asiasi e faigofie ona latou fiafia fa’atasi ma tamaiti i le taulaga.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: I le 20 tausaga talu ai, o le tele o filifiliga mo le fa’auō i tamaiti i le Taulaga o Salote ua matuā fa’ateteleina.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: E le fa’aaogāina tele taxi e aiga i Salote, e ui lava na mafai ona fa’aaogā i taimi o tulaga fa’afuase’ia.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: E iai le totogi fa’aopoopo o le ova atu ma le to’a2 le pasese, o lea filifiliga e ono matuā taugata ai na i lo le mea talafeagai.
eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: E 'aupito malūlū Antarctica i le Lalolagi atoa, ma e si'omia ai e le Pole i Matū.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: E taugata pe a āsia e turisi, e mana’omia le malosi o le tino, ia faia i le tau mafanafana ia Novema-Fepuari, ma e tele ina gata i le Penisula, o Atu Moto ma le Sami o Ross.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: E lua ’afe tagata faigaluega e nonofo ai i le tau mafanafana i nofoaga pe fāsefulu valu i totonu o ia ’itulagi; e la’iti’iti se aofa’i e nonofo ai i le tau mālūlū.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: O 'ele'ele i totonu o Antarctica o se mafola poo se pelatō le ‘ainā ma e ufitia i le 'aisa e 2-3 kilomita le māfiafia.
eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: E ta’itasitasi nai malaga i le ’ea e o’o i ele’ele i totonu, mo e a’ea’e i mauga pe fia oo i le Pole, lea o loo i ai se nofoaga tele.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: O le Pole Traverse i Saute (po o le Aualatele) e 1600 km laina mai le nofoaga o nofoaafi i McMurdo i luga o le Sami o Ross i le Pole.
eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: O le maopoopo o le kiona ma ta’eta’ei ua makaina i fu’a. E na o ta’avale masini palau fa’apitoa e mafai ona alu ai i luga, ma mea fa’asee toso, suāuu ma sapalai.
eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: E lē vave tele o lea e taamilo ai le auala i le ala ‘umi i le Mauga o Transantartic e sau ai i totonu o le gatasi.
eng_text: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: O mafua’aga taatele o fa’alavelave i tau malūlū o le maseesee o auala, pavements (auala savali) aemaise lava sitepu.
eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: A itiiti mai, e mana’omia seevae e talafeagai le aloise'evae. O seevae o le tau mafanafana e tele ina maseesee i luga o le ‘aisa ma le kiona, e oo foi i isi seevai o le taumalūlū e lē gafatiaina.
eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: O le pateni e tatau ona lava le loloto, 5 mm (1/5 inisi) po o le sili atu, ma lava le vaivai o mea e fa’aaogā i le malūlū.
eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: O isi seevae boot e i ai mea e fa’apipii i le pito i lalo ma e iai foi mea e mafai ona toe fa’aopoopo iai mo vaega maseesee, e fetaui lelei ma le tele o seevae ma boots, i mulivaetetee po o alofivae.
eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: O mulivaetetee o seevae e tatau ona maulalo ma lautele. O le oneone, ‘ili’ili po o le masima (calcium chloride) e masani ona fa’asalalau i luga o auala po o ala savali ina ia fa’aleleia ai le tosoina o uta.
eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: O mauga ‘aisa solo e le o se mea e le masani ai; o a’ega tifato e matuā taofiofiina le solo lemū, ma o ‘aisa mafiafia e tele o le a solofa mai i lalo o ni ‘aisa solo.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: O le fa’afitauli o le kiona e mapiipii, o le mea lea e mana’omia ai se mea e fa’asolo ai i lalo, ma o nisi kiona e solo mai i lalo e mafai ona avea ma mafua’aga e solo uma mai ai i lalo.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: O nisi taimi o le mea e mua’i fa’atupuina le solo i lalo o le ‘aisa o le la ina ua mafanafana le kiona, o nisi taimi e tele ai le solo mai gaioiga o le natura, e masani o se tagata.
eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: O le asiosio o se ta’aviliviliga o le ea e vaivai tele le malosi, lea e mimitiina ea e fa’ataamilomilo i totonu ma luga.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Latou te fa’atupuina matagi malolosi (masani e 100-200 maila/itulā) ma e mafaia ona lia’iina i le ea mea mamafa, ma fe’ave’ai a o taavilivili le asiosio.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: E amata o ni funnel e sau mai ao afā, ma avea ai ma “asiosio” ina ua pa’i i le ‘ele’ele.
eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: O le VPN a le tagata lava ia (virtual private network) o se auala lelei e ‘alofia ai tulafono fa’apolokiki ma le vaavaaiga o IP fa’apisinisi.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: E matua’i lelei lava i web proxies mo le tele o mafua’aga: Latou te toe suia auala uma o le Initaneti, e le na o le http.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: E masani ona ofaina atu le bandwidth maualuga ma le ‘au’aunaga lelei. E fa’apolokalame le lokaina ma e faigata ai e sipai ona tatala.
eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: O kamupanī o fesoota’iga ua fai ma masani le ‘olegia o tagata i le mafua’aga o lenei mea, faimai o le “puipuiga mai le avefa’agaoi”.
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: O le mea moni, o tulafono fa’aitulagi e matuā leai se afaina ai o kopi fa’asolitulafono; o se kopi tutusa o se disk e ola lelei i so o se masini lea e ola ai foi le original.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: O le mafua’aga sa’o lava o le fa’ateleina ai pea o le paoa o kamupanī i a latou maketi; o mea uma e ‘auga lava i le taavili o le tupe.
eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Ona o valaau e fa’asoaina uma e le Initaneti mea e aga’i ai, e te le mana’omia le fa’aaogāina o se kamupanī telefoni e tu latalata atu i le mea e te nofo ai po o le mea e te malaga ai.
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: E leai foi se mea e mana’omia ai le aumaia o sau numera mai le nofoaga o e iai; e mafai ona maua mai i le satelite o fesoota’iga o le Initaneti i le vao o Moa, i Alaska ma filifili se numera e ta’u atu ai o e i le la o Arisona.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: O le mea masani, e tatau ona fa’atau ‘ese sau numera e mafai ona fa’aaogā i le tele o atunuu e fa’atagaina ai telefoni PSTN ona valaau atu iā te oe. O le mea e aumai ai le numera e iai le ‘ese’esega mo tagata e vili atu ia te oe.
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: O polokalame mo le fa’aliliuina o tusitusiga i totonu o le taimi sa’o - o polokalame e mafai ona fa’aliliuina otometi se vaega atoa o tusitusiga mai lea gagana i le isi.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: O nisi o nei polokalame i lenei vaega e mafai foi ona fa’aliliuina tusitusiga i gagana ‘ese i fa’ailoilo po o isi ata i le lalolagi moni pe a tuu le telefoni fe’avea’i a se tagata agai i ia ata.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: O masini fa’aliliu ua saoasaoa lona tomai, ma e tele ina aumaia fa’aliliuga e sili atu po o le itiiti o mea fa’asa’o (ma e seāseā iai ni tala fa’a’ole’ole), peita’i e tatau lava ona fa’aeteete auā e ono sēsē le fa’aliliuina o mea uma.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: O le tasi o polokalame lauiloa i lenei vaega o le Google Translate, lea e fa’atagaina fa’aliliuga e aunoa ma se Initaneti ina ua uma ona tuu mai i lalo fa’amatalaga mana’omia o le gagana.
eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: O le fa’aaogāina o le polokalame fa’atonutonu o le GPS i lau telefoni fe’avea’i, e mafai ona avea ma se auala sili ona faigofie ma le fa’atuatuaina e tapasa ai ina ua e to’esea ma lou atunuu.
eng_text: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: E sefe ai le tupe i le fa’atauina o fa’afanua fou mo le GPS, po o se masini GPS po o le lisiina mai se kamupanī taavale totogi.
eng_text: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Afai e leai ni au data fesoota’i i lau telefoni po o ua e mamao ‘ese ma le mamao fa’atulagaina, o le a faatapulaa le avanoa e fa’aaogāina ai po o le lē ola foi.
eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: O tulimanu uma o fale’oloa e fa’atumuina i laina fenumia’i o pre-paid phone cards lea e mafai ona fa’aaogā mai telefoni totogi po o telefoni masani.
eng_text: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: E ui i le tele o cards e aogā mo le vili i so o se mea, o isi e fa’apitoa i le aumaia o tau lelei mo valaau i kulupu o atunuu fa’apitoa.
eng_text: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: O le avanoa i nei ‘au’aunaga e masani e ala atu i se numera valaau fua e mafai ona viliina mai le tele o telefoni e aunoa se totogi.
eng_text: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: O tulafono mo pu’ega ata masani e apalai foi i le pu’eina o ata vitiō, masalo e tele atu.
eng_text: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Afai o le pu’eina o se ata o se mea e le fa’atagaina, ona le tatau lea ona e mafaufau e pu’e se ata vitiō.
eng_text: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Afai e fa’aaoga se masini pu’eata fa’atonutonu (drone), muamua siaki lelei po o a mea e fa’ataga ona pu’eina ma o le a foi le pemita po o le laisene fa’aopoopo e mana’omia.
eng_text: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: O le fa’aleleina o le masini pu’eata fa’atonutonu e latalata i se malae vaalele po o luga o le tumutumu o tagata o se gaioiga e lē lelei, tusa lava pe lē se solitulafono i lou atunuu.
eng_text: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: O aso nei o faigamalaga i luga o le ea ua seāseā ona su’eina sa’o se avanoa i le ofisa malaga e aunoa ma le su’eina muamua ma fa’atusatusa tau.
eng_text: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: O nisi taimi o le malaga lava e tasi e mafai ona telē se ‘ese’esega i tau i le tele o kamupanī ma e totogi le fa’atusatusaina o i’uga o su’esu’ega fa’apea ai foi ma le matamata i le uepesite a le kamupanī vaalele ae le i faia le fa’atau.
eng_text: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: E ui ina le mana’omiaina se visa fa’atagata tafao po o le pisinisi mo malaga pupuu i nisi o atunuu, o le alu i ai o se tamaititi a’oga fa’a-va-o-malō e tele ina mana’omia le umi o le nofo na i lo le alu o se tagata tafao.
eng_text: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: I se tulaga lautele, o le nofo i so o se atunuu ‘ese mo se taimi umi o le a mana’omia le faia muamua o sou visa.
eng_text: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: O visa o tamaiti a’oga e masani ona iai mea ‘ese’ese e mana’omia ma fa’agasologa o pepa fa’atumu mai visa masani mo turisi po o le visa fa’apisinisi.
eng_text: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Mo le tele o atunuu, o le a e mana’omia se tusi talia mai le a’oga lea e te fia a’oga ai, fa’apea foi fa’amaoniga o tupe e tausia ai oe mo le tausaga muamua o lau mata’upu.
eng_text: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Siaki i le a’oga, fa’apea foi le matagaluega o femalagaa’iga o le atunuu o lo o e fia a’oga ai, mo fa’amatalaga au’ili’ili o mea e mana’omia.
eng_text: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Se’i vagana o oe o se sui ofisa o se atunuu, o le faigaluega ai i fafo o lona uiga e tatau ona faila le lafoga o lau tupe maua i le atunuu o lo o e nofo ai.
eng_text: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: O le lafoga o tupe maua e fa’atulaga ‘ese’ese i le tele o atunuu, ma o le fua fa’atatau o lafoga ma le fa’avasegaina e fesuisuia’i mai lea atunuu i le isi.
eng_text: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: I nisi o atunuu tuufa’atasi, e iai le Iunaite Setete ma Kanata, o lafoga o tupe maua e tuuina i luga o vaega uma e lua o le vaega tuufa’atasi ma le lotoifale, o le mea lea o fua fa’atatau ma le fa’avasegaina e mafai ona fesuisuia’i mai lea itulagi i lea itulagi.
eng_text: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: E ui ina masani ona leai se siaki a le ofisa o femalagaa’iga po o se tulaga aloa’ia ina ua e taunuu i lou atunuu, o siaki a le ofisa o tiute e ono avea ma fa’afitauli.
eng_text: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Ia e mautinoa e te iloa le mea e mafai ona aumai i totonu ma le mea e lē mafai ma fa’ailoa so o se mea i limiti fa’atulafonoina.
eng_text: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: O le auala pito faigofie e amata ai le pisinisi o tusitusiga a’o malaga o le fa’aleleia o lou agavaa i luga o le uepesite i se itulau (blog) ua faia mo malaga.
eng_text: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: E te masani loa ma e fiafia i le fa’avasegaina ma le fa’aleleiina i luga o le ‘upega tafa’ilagi, masalo i se taimi mulimuli ane e ono mafai ai ona e faia sa oe uepesite.
eng_text: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: O le volenitia a o malaga o se auala lelei tele mo se suiga ae e lē na o le foa’i atu.
eng_text: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: O le nofo ai ma volenitia i se atunuu ‘ese o se auala lelei e malamalama ai i se aganuu e lē masani ai, feiloa’i ai ma tagata fou, e te iloa ai lou tagata, maua ai lou malamalama i vaega ‘ese’ese ma fa’atupuina ai foi se tomai fou.
eng_text: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: E mafai foi ona avea ma se auala lelei e fa’alautele ai le paketi mo le ‘umi o le nofo i se mea auā o le tele o galuega volenitia e saunia potu ma fale ma e to’aitiiti e totogiina se tupe la’itiiti.
eng_text: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Sa fa’aaogāina e Vikings ālavai o Lusia e ui atu ai i le Sami Uliuli ma le Caspian Sea. O vaega o ia vai o lo o mafai pea ona fa’aaogā. Siaki mea e tatau mo pemita fa’apitoa, auā e ono faigata ona maua.
eng_text: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: O le Sami Pa’epa’e-Baltic Canal e fesoota’i ai le Vasa Atika i le Sami Paletika, e ui atu i le Vaituloto o Onega, Vaituloto o Ladoga ma Saint Petersburg, e tele ina ui atu i vaitafe ma vaituloto.
eng_text: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: O le Vaituloto o Onega e fesoota’i foi i Volga, o le mea lea, o le sau mai le Caspian Sea e ui atu i Lusia o la e mafai lava.
eng_text: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Ia mautinoa o le taimi lava e te taunuu ai i le marina o mea uma ua matuā manino. O le a e feiloa’i atu i isi tagata o su’e ni latou vaa ma o le a fa’asoa atu foi latou fa’amatalaga ia te oe.
eng_text: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: E mautinoa o le a e tuuina ni fa’asalalauga e ofaina atu ai lau fesoasoani, fesavalia’i i le uafu, talanoa atu i tagata o lo o fufuluina a latou vaa, taumafai e fesoota’i atu i seila i le pa, ma isi.
eng_text: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Taumafai e talanoa i tagata e to’atele pe a talafeagai ai. I se taimi puupuu, o le a iloa uma e tagata oe ma tuuina atu ai ni fa’amatalaga fa’a’alo’alo po o le fea le vaa o lo o mana’omia se isi.
eng_text: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: E tatau ona filifili lau kamupanī vaalele Frequent Flyer ma le fa’aeteete i se vaega o kamupanī galulue fa’atasi.
eng_text: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: E ui atonu e te mafaufau e atamai lou lesitala i le kamupanī vaalele o lo o e lele soo ai, e tatau ona e iloa o avanoa e ofa e masani ona ‘ese’ese ma o togi mai malaga sosoo e ono i lalo o kamupanī vaalele ‘ese’ese i le fa’apotopotoga e tasi o vaalele.
eng_text: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: O kamupanī vaalele e pei o le Emirate, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airways ua matuā fa’alauteleina la latou ‘au’aunaga i Aferika, ma ofa fesoota’iga i le tele o taulaga tetele o Aferika i tau fa’atauva na i lo isi vaalele a Europa.
eng_text: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: O le kamupanī vaalele o le Turkish, e 39 nofoaga i totonu o le 30 atunuu o Aferika e lele iai e oo ane i le 2014.
eng_text: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Afai e iai sou taimi fa’aopoopo, siaki e vaai le aofa’iga o lou pasese i le alu i Aferika fa’atusa i le pasese taamilo i le lalolagi.
eng_text: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: ‘Aua ne’i galo ona fa’aopoopo se tupe mo le tau o ni visa e ono mana’omia, lafoga tuua, auala o fesoota’iga i le lau’ele’ele, ma isi mo nofoaga uma i fafo o Aferika.
eng_text: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Afai e te fia malaga taamilo i le lalolagi atoa i le Southern Hemisphere, o vaalele e filifili mai iai ma fa’asinomaga e limiti ona o le lē lava o alāvaa i isi itu o le vasa.
eng_text: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: E leai ni kamupanī vaalele tuufa’atasi e kavaina kolosi i vasa e tolu i le Southern Hemisphere (ma o le SkyTeam e leai se kolosi na te kavaina).
eng_text: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Ae peita’i, o le Star Alliance e kavaina mea uma se’i vagana le Pasefika i Saute sasa’e mai Santiago de Chile e oo atu i Tahiti, lea o se malaga a le LATAM Oneworld.
eng_text: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: E le na o le pau lea o le faigāmalaga e te filifili mai iai pe a e mana’o e fa’amisi le Pasefika i Saute ma le talafatai i sisifo o Amerika i Saute. (silasila i lalo)
eng_text: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: I le 1994, o le ituaiga o le Arameni Nagorno-Karabakh o le itulagi o Azerbaijan sa fa’asagatau i le ‘au Aseri.
eng_text: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Fa’atasi ai ma le lagolago o le ‘au Arameni, sa fausia ai se faigāmalō fou. Peita’i, e leai se malō fa’avae - e oo lava ia Arameni - ua aloa’ia fa’atulafonoina.
eng_text: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: O finauga fa’ale-malō i luga o le itulagi ua fa’aauau ai le fa’aleagaina o sootaga i le va o Arameni ma Azerbaijan.
eng_text: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: O le Itumalō o Canal (Dutch: Grachtengordel) o le itumalō ta’uta’ua o le 17 seneturi e si’omiaina le Binnenstad o Amsterdam.
eng_text: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: O le itumalō atoa ua avea ma Measina o le Lalolagi a le UNESCO ona o lana aganuu mata’ina ma lona aogā fa’atalatuu, ma le taūa o ana meatotino e i le vaega maualuluga o le atunuu.
eng_text: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, o lona uiga o Fanua e Lima, e aofia ai nuu e lima i le talafatai o Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza ma Monterosso o lo o i le vaega Italia o Liguria.
eng_text: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: O lo o lisiina i Measina o le Lalolagi a le UNESCO.
eng_text: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: I le tele o seneturi, sa fausia e tagata ma le fa’aeteete ni fale fa’asitepu i luga o fanua gaoā, tifatō seia oo lava i luga o papa maualuga e fa’asaga i le sami.
eng_text: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: O le matagofie o lea vaega o le tau leai o ni atina’e fa’apisinisi e iloa atu. O auala, nofoaafi ma vaa e fesoota’i ai nuu, ma taavale e lē mafai ona oo atu ai mai fafo.
eng_text: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: O ituaiga o le gagana Farani e tautatala ai i Peleseuma (Belgium) ma Suiselani (Switzerland) e ‘ese’ese la’itiiti lava mai le gagana Farani i totonu o Farani, e ui ina tutusa lelei mo le femalamalamaa’i ai.
eng_text: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Aemaise lava, o le sistema fa’anumera i le gagana Farani e tautalaina i Peleseuma ma Suiselani e iai nai ‘ese’esega laiti e ‘ese mai ai i le gagana Farani e tautalaina i Farani, ma o le fa’aleoina o nisi o upu e ‘ese’ese la’itiiti.
eng_text: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Ae ui i lea, o Peleseana (Belgians) uma ma Suisi (Swiss) e tautatala i le fa’a-Farani e ono a’oa’oina le gagana Farani masani i a’oga, ina ia mafai ona latou malamalama ia te oe tusa lava pe e te fa’aaogāina le sisitema fa’anumera i le gagana masani a Farani.
eng_text: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: I le tele o vaega o le lalolagi, o le talotalo o se gaioiga fa’auō, o le fa’ailoga o le “fa’atalofa” (hello).
eng_text: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Peita’i, i Meleisia, i se vaega itiiti o Melei i nuu i tua, o le uiga “sau ii”, e tutusa ma le lima tusi e lolo’u aga’i le tino, o se gaioiga lea e fa’aaogā i nisi o atunuu i Sisifo, ma e tatau ona fa’aaogāina tau lava o lenā mafua’aga.
eng_text: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: E fa’apena foi le tagata malaga mai Peretania i totonu o Spain e ono sēsē i le talotalo fa’atofā ma lona alofilima e fa’asaga ia te ia (ae le o le tagata lea e talotalo iai) o se fa’ailo o le toe sau.
eng_text: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: O gagana fesoasoani e fai e tagata po o gagana fausia sa faia ma le fa’amoemoe e fa’afaigofie ai fesoota’iga i le va o tagata e fa’afaigata fesoota’iga.
eng_text: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: E ‘ese mai le lingua francas, o gagana fa’ale-natura po o le gagana organic sa taulamua i le ‘auga e tasi po o le isi o se auala o fesoota’iga i le va o tagata tautatala i isi gagana.
eng_text: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: I le ‘aasa o le la, e mafai ona oo tagata malaga i le fa’asēsēina o mafaufauga lea e maua ai le vaaia o vai e le o iai (po o isi mea).
eng_text: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: E matuā mata’utia lenei mea pe afai e tulituliloaina e le tagata malaga vaaiga fa’asēsē, fa’ama’imauina ai le malosi taūa ma vaiinu o totoe.
eng_text: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: E oo lava i le toafa pito sili ona vevela e ogaoga le malūlū i le po. O le maalili o se tulaga taufa’amata’u pe a leai ni ofu mafanafana.
eng_text: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Aemaise lava i le tau mafanafana, e mana’omia lou fa’aeteete i namu pe a e mafaufau e te savalia le vaomatua.
eng_text: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: E oo lava i lou ‘aveina o le taavale i totonu o le vaomatua i le vaega teropika, o ni nai sekone e matala ai faitoto’a a’o e oso i totonu o le taavale ua lava ma totoe lea mo namu e te lua o fa’atasi ai.
eng_text: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: O le fulū o le manulele, po o le avian influenza lea e sili ona iloa aloa’ia ai, e mafai ona aafia ai manulele ma mammals.
eng_text: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: E itiiti ifo i le afe mea tutupu na lipotia i tagata, ae o nisi o na mea sa lamatia ai le ola.
eng_text: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: O le tele na aafia ai tagata e galulue i lafu moa, ae e i ai foi popolega i tagata matamata i manulele.
eng_text: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: O le vaaiga masani mo Nouei o vanu loloto ua fa’atumuina e le sami, ma vanu e fa’afuase’i ona fa’atuputupula’ia i se maualuga, o le sili atu po o le itiiti ifo i se laufanua laugatasi.
eng_text: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: O ia laufanua laugatasi e masani ona fa’asinoina i ai o le “vidde” o lona uiga o se laufanua lautele, e leai ni laau, o se fa’alautelega e leai sona tuā’oi.
eng_text: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: I Rogaland ma Agder e masani ona ta’ua o le “hei” o lona uiga o se fanua gaoā e leai ni laau ma tele ina ufitia e le vao mafiafia.
eng_text: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: O ‘aisa e le matūtū, ae tafe ifo i lalo o le mauga. O le mea lea e mafua ai fenutia’iga, āva tetele, lea e ono punitia e auala laupapa ‘aisa.
eng_text: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: O pa puipui ma taualuga o ana ‘aisa e ono tou’ulu mai i lalo ma mafai ona tapunia ai āva.
eng_text: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: O poloka lapopo’a i vaega tupito o ‘aisa e matagataga ma to’uulu i lalo ma masalo e oso ‘ese pe ta’avalevale mamao ma le fa’atausi’usi’uga.
eng_text: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: O vaitau o turisi i nofoaga maupu’epu’e e masani ona maualuga i taimi o le tau mafanafana i Initia.
eng_text: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Ae peita’i, e ‘ese’ese lo latou lalelei ma foliga fa’atosina i le vaitaimi o tau malūlū, fa’atasi ai ma le tele o nofoaga ā’ēgā e fa’amatagofieina e le kiona ma fai ai taaloga e pei o skiing ma snowboarding.
eng_text: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: E laiti nai kamupanī vaalele o lo o ofaina pea pasese pā’ū mo tagata o latou aiga e iai tagata maliliu, lea e tuuina ai sina fa’aitiiti i pasese o malaga i maliu i se taimi puupuu.
eng_text: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: O kamupani vaalele o lo o ofaina ia ‘au’aunaga e aofia ai le Ea Kanata, Delta Airlines, Lufthansa mo faigāmalaga e sau mai le U.S. po o Kanata, ma WestJet.
eng_text: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: I malaga uma, e tatau ona faia lou avanoa e ala i le fesoota’i sa’o i le telefoni a le kamupanī vaalele.
eng_text: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
